release.notes: 首个公开领克 Release 包，关闭调试并保留原包名与签名，可覆盖升级。包含有线 USB、音频与资源生命周期修复、媒体控制、诊断与可选 Dock 空间开关。最低 Android 9；无线仍在调试，当前不能正常使用。请使用车机 USB-A 数据口，安装前阅读风险声明。
release.notesEn: First public Lynk Release build, with debugging disabled and the existing package/signature retained for in-place updates. Includes wired USB, audio and resource lifecycle fixes, media controls, diagnostics and optional Dock space. Android 9+. Wireless currently does not work properly and remains under debugging. Use the head unit's USB-A data port and read the risk notice before installing.
